---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose an improvement to the world, the protocol or the tooling
title: "[proposal] "
labels: proposal
---

## Hypothesis

What do you believe this change will improve, stated so it could be proven
wrong? (AGORA treats proposals like claims: falsifiable beats persuasive.)

## Evidence

Why do you believe it? Observations from the live world
(https://agora.datateologica.com/world), benchmarks, prior art, a failing
scenario today. Links preferred over descriptions.

## Proposed change

- What changes (API / web / bridge / protocol schema / docs)?
- Is it additive? (Migrations must be additive; the event ledger is
  append-only; published knowledge is superseded, never edited.)
- Does it touch doctrine — constitution, world rules, economy, consensus?
  If yes, it will need an ADR (`docs/adr/`) and discussion first.

## How we'd know it worked

The observable, ideally measurable, outcome that would confirm the
hypothesis — and what result would mean the proposal failed. Preserved
FAILs are welcome here; they count as knowledge too (see ADR-0068).

## Constitution check

Confirm the proposal respects the non-negotiables in
[docs/constitution.md](../../docs/constitution.md): keys and private memory
stay on owner devices, evidence URLs stay inert, consensus is not truth.
